translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Moo'aaba Pirddaa

Moo'aaba biittaa s'eelliyaawaan Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday, Israa'eeliyaa S'oossay hawaadan yaagee; «Nabo katamaw aayye ana! Ayaw gooppe, I bayana. K'iriyaatayima katamay kawushshananne omoodettana; unttunttu geessuukka kawushshananne me"erettana.

Hawaappe hini baggan Moo'aaba c'eek'uu d'ayana. Ayaw gooppe, Haseboona kataman de'iyaa Asay Moo'aaba bolla, ‹Haayite! He biittaa ane ubbaanna d'ayisseeto› yaagiide iitabaa mak'etteedda. Neenoo, Maadimeena katamatiw, neenakka sirp'p'i ootsana; ne geeduwaa olay kaallana.
«Horonayma asay, ‹Laaletsaynne wolk'k'aama bashshay gakkeeda› yaagiide waassiyaa waasuwaa sisite!
Moo'aabe me"erettana; Aa naanatuu yeekkiyaa yeekuwaa sisite!
Unttunttu yeekkiidde, Luhiita pudetsaa kesana; Horonayma dugetsaakka bashshaw waassiyaawanttu waasuwaa sisiide wod'd'ana.
Unttunttu ittuu ittuwaa, ‹Bak'atite! hintte shemppuwaa ashshite!› Mela dembbaan de'iyaa Aaro'eera katamaa mala gidite.

Neenoo, Moo'aaba biittaw, neeni ne wolk'k'aaninne ne duretetsan c'eek'etteedda diraw, neenikka omoodettana. K'ay Kaamoosha giyaa s'oossaykka bare k'eesetuwaanne bare mooddiyaawanttunna ittippe omoodettiide, harasaa baana.
Med'inaa Goday odeeddawaadan, katamatuwaa ubbaa d'ayissiyaawe yaana; itti kataminne de'enna; wombbaynne dembbay ubbay ittippe d'ayana.
Moo'aabaw I paalliide attiyaa k'efiyaa immite. Aa katamatuu ubbay ayinne baynnawaa gidana; itti asaynne unttunttun de'enna.
«Med'inaa Godaa oosuwaa sheneko giide ootsiyaa uray shek'k'etteeddawaa gido! S'oossay azazi wotsina, suutsaa gussennaadan bare mashshaa te"iyaa uraykka shek'k'etteeddawaa gido!

«Moo'aabe yalagatetsaappe doommiide, ishaluwaan de'eedda asaa mala; I hara biittaw omoodettibeenna. Moo'aabe baatsaappe baatsaw tigettennaaninne k'aas's'ennan, mal"uu laamettennaaninne sawuu aggenaan, uttiide de'iyaa woyniyaa eessaa mala.
Moo'aaba aatsi yeggiyaawantta taani Med'inaa Goday kiittiyaa gallassatuu yaana. Unttunttu Aa aatsi yeggiide, baatsaappe c'inggirssana; Aa baatsaa mentsereetsana.
Yaatina, Israa'eeliyaa Asay bare ammanetteeda, Beeteelen de'iyaa eek'an kawusheeddawaadan, Moo'aaba asaykka bare s'oossan Kaamooshan kawushshana.
«Hintte, ‹Nuuni wolk'k'aama asanne mino olanchchaa› giide ayaw c'eek'ettiitee?
Be'ite, Moo'aaba biittaynne yaan de'iyaa katamatuu bayeeddino. Aa yalaga attuma asatuukka shukettanaw duge beeddino. Taani Kaatii, Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Godaa geetettiyaawe hawaa oday.
Moo'aaba bashshay matatteedda; tuggay Aa bollan yiyaa wodiikka elleelliide gakkeedda.
«Aa yuushshuwaan de'iyaa asaw, Aa woggatetsaakka eriyaa ubbaw, ‹Mino gideedda kawutetsaa s'am"ay waan me"eeddee! Bonchchetteedda s'am"ay waan kinchchetteedee!› yaagiide zilaalite.
«Hinttenoo, Diboona kataman de'iyaawanttoo, hintte bonchcho sa'aappe wod'd'iide, mela biittan uttite. Ayaw gooppe, Moo'aaba d'ayissiyaawe hintte bollankka yaana; hintte geessuwaa ubbaakka laalana.
«Aaro'eera kataman de'iyaawanttoo, ogiyaa doonaan ek'k'iide s'eellite; kessi akkiide bak'atiyaa attuma asaanne mac'c'a asaa, ‹Ayee kesseeddawe?› yaagiide oochchite.
«Unttunttu, ‹Moo'aabe me"eedda diraw kawusheedda; aw yeekkitenne zilaalite! Moo'aabe bayeeddawaa Arnnoona Shaafaa lank'k'iyaan awaayite!› yaagiide zaarana.
«Gezziyaan de'iyaa Holoona, Yaahis'a, Mefa'aata,
Diboona, Nabo, Beeti-Dibilaatayima,
K'iriyaatayima, Beeti-Gamuula, Beeti-Ma'oona,
K'iriyaatanne, Boos'ira geetettiyaa katamatuwaa bollaninne mataaninne haakuwaan de'iyaa Moo'aaba katamatuwaa bollan pirdday yeedda.
Moo'aaba kac'ii k'ans's'etteedda; Aa k'esiikka me"eedda.
«Med'inaa Godaa bollan otoretteedda diraw, Moo'aaba ushshiide matsoyite. Bare c'oosheedda c'ooshshaa bollan gonddoretto; Asay ubbaykka Aa bollan k'iliic'o.
Kase neeni Israa'eeliyaa bollan k'iliic'abeykkii? Aabaa haasayiyaa wode, neeni kad'aade huup'iyaa k'aatseeddawe Israa'eelii kayisotuwaa giddoppe oyk'k'ettiineeyye?
«Hinttenoo, Moo'aaban de'iyaawanttoo, katamaappe kesi biide, Shuchchaa gonggoluwaa giddon de'ite. Aafuwaa doonaan bare golliyaa kees's'iyaa harap'p'atti mala gidite.
Moo'aabe loytsi otoretteedda; Moo'aaba Asay ay keeshshaa ayyintto, aleek'inttonne otorettintto, k'ay barentta unttunttu ay keeshshaa d'ok'k'issi wotseeddentto, taani sisaad.
Taani Med'inaa Goday unttunttu aleek'k'uwaa eray; shin ayinne maaddenna; unttunttu c'eek'uukka ayaakka ootsenna.
Hewaa diraw, taani Moo'aabaw waassay; K'iirihereesa asawukka kayyottaade yeekkay.

«Hinttenoo, Siibima asaw, Yaa'izeera asaw yeekkiyaawaappe aatsaade taani hinttew yeekkay. Hintte tashii daashiide, Mas'iyaa Abbaa pinniide, Yaa'izeera gakkeedda woyniyaa turaa mala; shin hintte ofintsaa teeraanne hintte woyniyaa wurc'c'uwaa bonk'k'iyaawanttu yiide d'ayissidiggeeddino.

Lo"o katsay ayifiyaa Moo'aaba biittaappe pashikkaynne nashechchay aketti kichcheedda. Woynniyaa teeraa gum"iyaa sa'atuwaappekka woyniyaa eessay goggennaadan te"a diggaad. Ooninne laa"entso Aa ililiiddi gum"enna. Asaa kooshshay sisettooppekka, nashshechchaa kooshsha gidenna.

«Unttunttu Haseboonaaninne El"aalen waassiyaa waasuu Yahaas'a gakkanaw sisettee. K'ay S'oo'aaroppe biide, Horonaymanne Egilaati-Shaliishiyaa gakkanaw sisettee. Haray atto Nimiriima haatsaykka meleedda.
«Taani Moo'aaban Asay goyinniyaa d'ok'k'a sa'atuwaan yarshshiyaawantta barenttu s'oossatoo is'aanaa c'uwayiyaawantta d'ayissana. Taani Med'inaa Goday hawaa oday.
Unttunttu kase demmeedda duretetsay ubbay ha"i d'ayikichcheedda diraw, ta wozanay Moo'aabawunne K'iirihereesa asaw baliyaan his'is'iyaan yeekkiyaawaadan yeekkee.
Unttunttu ubbay barenttu huup'iyaanne barenttu buuchchaa meedeeddino; barenttu kushiyaakka k'ans's'iide madutseeddino; k'ay barenttu s'eessankka maak'aa danc'c'eeddino.
Moo'aaban de'iyaa golliyaa huup'iyaa ubbaaninne dabaaban yeekuwaappe attina, harabay baawa. Ayaw gooppe, Moo'aaba taani ooninne koyenna otuwaadan mentsaad. Taani Med'inaa Goday hawaa oday.

«Moo'aabe ay me'uwaa me"eeddee! Aa asaynne ay waasuwaa waassi! Moo'aabe yeellatiide, bare zokkiyaa wora ay zaaruwaa zaarii! Hewaa diraw, Moo'aabe bare yuushshuwaan de'iyaa ubbatoo miic'c'iyaawaanne dagammiyaabaa gideedda» yaagee.
Med'inaa Goday hawaadan yaagee; «Arggantsay bare k'efiyaa piddi ootsi paalliidde yiyaawaadan, morkkii Moo'aaba bollan yaana.
Aa katamatuu oyk'k'ettana; Aa geesatuukka aketana. He gallassi Moo'aaba mino olanchchatuwaa wozanaykka oytsay oyk'k'eedda mac'c'a mishirati wozanaa mala gidanawaa.
Moo'aabe ta bollan, Med'inaa Godaa bollan makkaleedda diraw d'ayana; hawaappe sintsaw I kawutetsaa gidenna.
«Hinttenoo, Moo'aaban de'iyaawanttoo, yashshiyaawe, ollaynne p'irii hinttena naagee. Taani Med'inaa Goday hawaa oday.

Yashshiyaawaappe bak'atiide wos's'iyaa ooninne ollaan kunddana; k'ay ollaappe pude kesiyaa ooninne p'iriyaan oyk'k'ettana. Ayaw gooppe, taani Moo'aaba muriyaa wodiyaan hewaa ootsana. Med'inaa Goday hawaa oday.

«Bak'atiide beeddawanttu wolk'k'aa d'ayiide, Haseboona katamaa kuwan ek'k'eeddino. Ayaw gooppe, Haseboona katamaappe tamay, k'ay Kaatii Sihooni beni de'eedda golliyaappe lac'uu kesiide, Moo'aaba biittaa ubbaanne an de'iyaa makkalanchcha asaa maana.
Moo'aaba asaw, hinttew aayye ana! Kaamoosha giyaa s'oossaw goyinniyaawanttu d'ayeeddino; unttunttu attuma naanatuunne mac'c'a naanatuu omoodettiide beeddino.
«Gidooppenne, wurssetsa wodetuwaan taani Moo'aaba asaw zaaraadde sa'aa ishalissana. Taani Med'inaa Goday hawaa oday» yaagee. Moo'aaba bolla odetteedda timbbitii hawaan wureedda.
